top_signals.title: Four Oil Tankers Struck by Hormuz Explosions
top_signals.summary: Four oil tankers were hit by explosions in the Strait of Hormuz, Iran's military said on Thursday, adding that the vessels had ignored warnings and entered what it considers restricted areas of the strategic waterway.Tankers are still facing attacks across the strait…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Finland Detects Strike on Baltic Sea Russian Warship
top_signals.summary: Finland's military said on Thursday its forces had detected "a strike" on a Russian warship in the Baltic Sea a day earlier, but that the security situation in the area remained stable.It was not immediately clear if there were any casualties or what had caused the strike.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Oil Prices Rise $1/Barrel As Disruptions Continue in Strait of Hormuz
top_signals.summary: Oil prices rose on Thursday by more than $1 a barrel, as continued disruptions to shipping through the Strait of Hormuz and broader geopolitical tensions offset pressure from rising crude output that had sent prices lower in early trade.Brent…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Correspondence: Asset Purchase Facility (APF) ceiling, November 2026
top_signals.summary: The Chancellor of the Exchequer and the Governor of the Bank of England jointly agreed to reduce the maximum authorised size of the APF. This was confirmed via a letter exchange on 10 November 2026.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
